participation.context: Priced the sitting once, and would not have a second loaf.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Put the rest under the cloth, and left the paper blank.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

story.body: You took three bites and left the pages where they were. You paid the sitting and did not open the coffer.
